JUDGE: REWARDKIT_JUDGE/MODEL only in task.toml:30-35 [verifier.env] (frozen block exact); each judge.toml carries only the 'claude-code' fallback, no model. RESTART VAR: test.sh:193 export APP_RESTART_HELPER = functional judge.toml:27 '$APP_RESTART_HELPER' = functional prompt 'Restart evidence' (restart_app of verifier server, persistence last) and persistence is criterion 16 of 16 in file order. COUNTS: task.toml description/provenance quote no criterion count; the only quoted count is functional judge.toml:9 '16 x 550 + 900 + 900 = 10600 s' within 'the 11100 s scored budget' - re-derived: 16 functional [[criterion]] blocks, polish/visual timeout 900 each, test.sh:224 'run_suite scored 11100'; template default 'batched/9000' in the comment matches template functional judge.toml lines 3-4. Gates 600+600 < 1500 (test.sh:213), 1500+11100 < 13200 (task.toml:27). Name 'Kittle & Rowe matter chat' in app_context:3 = render criterion = server.js:519 log. Literals 'On hold', 'edited', 'new messages', 'not available', 390 px phone width agree between notes and criteria. Golden agreement is backed by the hash-verified scripted golden run (functional-before.json: all 15 pre-restart functional checks true; functional-after.json persistence true) - scripted evidence only, not a configured judge run, Oracle grade or score. Adversarial attempts: (a) a broken app relying on /assets at runtime instead of copying still sees the same seed because task.toml artifacts carry /assets and server-side fallbacks are the app's choice - not a contract drift; (b) a conforming app writing to DB_PATH or to /app/app.db gets the same file in both launch and restart (test.sh:98/101 and heredoc share APP_DB), so no conforming app is failed by a path mismatch; (c) cwd-independence promised in integration.md:3 matches test.sh never cd'ing into /app. Note (not drift): public timing tolerances differ by design - conversations.md:31 'within about five seconds', walls-and-retention.md:19 'within a few seconds', criteria 'within about ten seconds' - the criteria are the more lenient bound, so they never fail an app that meets the brief; app_context lists Harriet as '(timers and holds)' without walls, an omission rather than a contradiction. Out of scope for this row and not judged here: task.toml category 'Messaging & Chat Interfaces' vs contract example 'programming' (identity row), and the unmeasured individual-mode workload (comment itself says 'Not yet measured').
